title: 第5章 杨康4第6章 杨康5
content_zh:
完颜洪烈此时还沉浸在自己好大儿的武功上面，听着他的话，一时之间倒是没反应过来。
杨康见此，只好又重复了一遍。
其他人见杨康一副另有内情的样子，也纷纷停下了手！
完颜洪烈看着包惜弱，只觉得心都要碎了，但这么多年的守候不是假的，他还是想为自己争取一下！
“惜弱，你真的要跟他走吗？你难道一点也不顾念我们十几年的感情吗？”
杨铁心听着这话，只感觉怒火中烧，他本身就极为看重自己的面子。自己的妻子送了自己好大一份见面礼啊！现在对方居然还在挑衅，这简直是对他的侮辱！
包惜弱听着完颜洪烈的话，心里倒不是没有一点触动，毕竟对方悉心照顾她十几年，怎么可能完全没感觉呢！但她心里爱的人是铁哥啊！
“抱歉！王爷，我是铁哥的妻子，自然是要和他在一起的，您对我和康儿的照顾，我们无以为报！只能......”说着说着包惜弱又开始了自己悲天悯人的哭
杨康听着包惜弱的话，简直无语，你现在知道你是杨铁心的妻子，那你享受完颜洪烈照顾的时候怎么不说，说到底还是有选择了，不然绝对不会说这句话！
本身自己是不想理会他们这些爱恨情仇的，但是包惜弱提到了自己，自己就不能任由她污蔑！不然他日大金皇室的人怎么看待他。
反正记忆已经改完了，除了他自己，谁也不知道真实情况！
“停！本世子很忙！没空听你说这些，直接说重点就行！”
其他人看着杨康这副样子，简直被气个半死！对自家母亲的态度都这样，绝对是被野蛮的金人教坏了！丘处机和杨铁心更是打定主意要帮他改过来！
郭靖看着杨康，忍不住说的：“康弟，你怎么能这么说呢！杨大叔杨大婶都是你的亲人啊！”
听着郭靖的指责，杨康嘴角不由抽了抽，这义正言辞的样子，不知道以为自己是救世主呢！第一次见面就叫康弟，说的好像他们很熟一样！
对于脑子不好的郭靖，杨康直接无视，目光灼灼看着完颜洪烈，示意他尽快解释！
看着自家儿子脸上的厌烦，完颜洪烈倒是没什么想法，毕竟他和自家儿子一起处理朝政，自然知道他不耐烦包惜弱的哭哭啼啼，也不喜欢别人无缘无故的攀关系，以前那完全是看着自己的面子和不常见面的份上忍了，不然还不知道怎么样呢！
完颜洪烈很清楚一旦解释清楚，他和包惜弱再无可能，但他不得不说啊！
当年的事情儿子早就知道，而且大金朝廷如今隐隐约约有了日落西山的趋势，康儿是唯一的指望，他不能对不起祖宗基业啊!
“惜弱，十八年了，这十八年来我对你如何你心里清楚，但我今天想告诉你，这十八年来，你心里藏着杨铁心，而我心里也埋藏着一个秘密，那就是康儿不是你的儿子！”

完颜洪烈这话一出，围观的众人根本不敢相信，谁会无缘无故替别人养孩子啊！这怕不是有病！
包惜弱简直不敢相信，自己养了十八年的儿子怎么就突然不是自己的了！
聪明人黄蓉当即反驳道：“你胡说！如果他不是，你凭什么养他！你不过是想要耍手段而已。”
黄蓉的话令众人回过神来，纷纷怀疑完颜洪烈是想要耍心眼，毕竟儿子可不是随随便便乱养的！
一时之间，众人都看向完颜洪烈，在等着他后续的解释！
杨康不由抽了抽嘴角，其实黄蓉的怀疑倒也没错，毕竟完颜洪烈的操作正常人确实理解不了！养着老婆和前夫的孩子，放任老婆整日怀念亡夫，确实不是一般人能干出来的事情！
完颜洪烈不清楚黄蓉的身份，但为了赶紧将事情解释清楚，还是将前因后果讲了一遍！
“当年你怀孕后期百般不适，孩子更是生而夭折。刚好我的妾室难产生下康儿，我为了让你有个寄托，才谎称康儿是你的孩子！”
“不，这不可能！康儿是我的儿子，是我养了十八年的儿子！”包惜弱接受不了这个事实，忍不住大声反驳道
“你不信也没办法，这是事实！你看看你和康儿，你们两个根本就没有相似的地方！正常血亲，无论多少，总会有相似的地方！”
包惜弱看着杨康，只觉得天旋地转，但还是说道“这不可能，绝对不可能！”
其他人听了完颜洪烈的话，看看杨铁心几个人，确实没看出来几人之间有相似的地方！难道完颜洪烈说的是真的？
杨康就站在那里，任由众人打量。他这张脸可是经过微调的，只能看出和完颜洪烈相似的地方，至于其他，那是不可能有的！
如果有，那就是系统太过废物！
作为聪明人的黄蓉，总感觉哪里有些不对，但却又想不起来！
直到看到杨康眼底的冷漠，才反应过来！
“既然你说这是你妾室所生的孩子，抱给了包惜弱，那你又怎么解释他们母子之间为什么这么冷淡呢！这根本不符合常理！”
content_en:
Wanyan Honglie was still immersed in his big boy's martial arts. Hearing his words, he didn't react for a moment.
Seeing this, Yang Kang had no choice but to repeat it again.
Seeing that Yang Kang looked like he had something up his sleeve, the others also stopped!
Wanyan Honglie looked at Bao Xiruo and felt that his heart was about to break. But the waiting for him for so many years was not a lie. He still wanted to fight for himself!
"Xi Ruo, do you really want to go with him? Don't you care about our relationship of more than ten years at all?"
Yang Tiexin felt angry when he heard this. He valued his own face very much. His wife gave him a big gift as a meeting gift! Now the other party is still provoking, which is simply an insult to him!
When Bao Xiruo listened to Wanyan Honglie's words, she was not untouched. After all, the other party had taken good care of her for more than ten years, how could she not feel anything at all! But the person she loves in her heart is Brother Tie!
"I'm sorry! Your Majesty, I am Brother Tie's wife, so naturally I want to be with him. We can't repay you for taking care of Kang'er and me! We can only..." As he said this, Bao Xiruo began to cry pitifully.
Yang Kang was speechless listening to Bao Xiruo's words. Now that you know that you are Yang Tiexin's wife, why didn't you say this when you were enjoying Wanyan Honglie's care? After all, you still have a choice, otherwise you would never say this!
I don't want to pay attention to their love and hatred, but when Bao Xiruo mentions me, I can't let her slander her! Otherwise, how will the people of the Daijin royal family treat him in the future?
Anyway, the memory has been changed, and no one knows the real situation except himself!
"Stop! My prince is very busy! I don't have time to listen to what you say, just talk about the key points!"
When the others looked at Yang Kang like this, they were so angry that they almost died! He has such an attitude towards his mother, he must have been corrupted by the barbaric Jin people! Qiu Chuji and Yang Tiexin were even more determined to help him change!
Guo Jing looked at Yang Kang and couldn't help but say: "Brother Kang, how can you say that! Uncle Yang and Aunt Yang are all your relatives!"
Listening to Guo Jing's accusation, Yang Kang couldn't help but twitch the corners of his mouth. With such righteous words, he thought he was the savior! When we first met, we called him Kangdi, as if they were familiar with each other!
Yang Kang ignored Guo Jing, who was mentally ill, and looked at Wanyan Honglie with stern eyes, signaling him to explain as soon as possible!
Seeing the boredom on his son's face, Wanyan Honglie had no idea. After all, he and his son were handling government affairs together, so he naturally knew that he was impatient with Bao Xiru's crying, and he didn't like other people's unreasonable relationships. In the past, he only tolerated it for the sake of his own face and the infrequent meeting, otherwise I don't know what would happen!
Wanyan Honglie knew very well that once the explanation was clear, there would be no possibility between him and Bao Xiruo, but he had to say it!
My son has long known what happened back then, and the Jin Dynasty is now vaguely on the verge of sunset. Kang'er is the only hope. He can't let down the inheritance of his ancestors!
"Xi Ruo, it's been eighteen years. You know how I have treated you in these eighteen years, but I want to tell you today that in these eighteen years, you have hidden Yang Tiexin in your heart, and I have also buried a secret in my heart, that is, Kang'er is not your son!"
As soon as Wanyan Honglie said these words, everyone watching couldn't believe it. Who would raise other people's children for no reason! I'm afraid this is not a disease!
Bao Xiruo couldn't believe how the son he had raised for eighteen years was suddenly no longer his!
The smart Huang Rong immediately retorted: "You are talking nonsense! If he is not, why do you support him! You just want to use tricks."
Huang Rong's words brought everyone back to their senses, and they all suspected that Wanyan Honglie was trying to play tricks. After all, his son was not raised casually!
Suddenly, everyone looked at Wanyan Honglie.Waiting for his subsequent explanation!
Yang Kang couldn't help but twitch the corner of his mouth. In fact, Huang Rong's suspicion was correct. After all, Wanyan Honglie's operations were indeed incomprehensible to normal people! Raising a wife and her ex-husband's children, and letting her miss her late husband all day long is really not something that ordinary people can do!
Wanyan Honglie didn't know Huang Rong's identity, but in order to quickly explain the matter clearly, he still explained the cause and effect!
"Back then, you suffered from various discomforts during the late pregnancy, and the child even died at birth. It happened that my concubine had difficulty giving birth to Kang'er, so in order to give you something to rely on, I lied and claimed that Kang'er was your child!"
"No, this is impossible! Kang'er is my son, the son I have raised for eighteen years!" Bao Xiruo couldn't accept this fact and couldn't help but retorted loudly
"You can't help it if you don't believe it. It's a fact! Look at you and Kang'er. You two have no similarities at all! Normal blood relatives, no matter how many, will always have similarities!"
Bao Xiruo looked at Yang Kang and felt like the world was spinning, but he still said, "This is impossible, absolutely impossible!"
After listening to Wanyan Honglie's words, the others looked at Yang Tiexin and the others, and they really didn't see any similarities between them! Could it be that what Wanyan Honglie said was true?
Yang Kang just stood there, letting everyone look at him. His face has been fine-tuned, and it can only be seen that he is similar to Wanyan Honglie. As for the rest, it is impossible!
If so, then the system is too rubbish!
As a smart person, Huang Rong always felt that something was wrong, but she couldn't remember it!
It wasn't until he saw the indifference in Yang Kang's eyes that he realized it!
"Since you said this is the child born to your concubine and you gave it to Bao Xiruo, then how do you explain why they are so cold between mother and son! This is not in line with common sense at all!"
